item.title: Judge blocks Trump administration from moving former death row inmates to Colorado’s ‘Supermax’ prison
item.description: U.S. District judge ruled the government cannot send the former death row inmates to the “Supermax” federal prison in Florence, Colorado, because it likely would violate their Fifth Amendment rights to due process.

item.title: Trump nominates a hospitality executive to lead the National Park Service
item.description: The nomination of Scott Socha follows widespread firings within the Park Service.

item.title: Schedule set for CSU Rams’ first season in Pac-12
item.description: The 12-game schedule features seven home games for the third consecutive season

item.title: NCAR-Wyoming Supercomputing Center to move to a new operator
item.description: The NCAR-Wyoming Supercomputing Center will no longer be operated by the National Center for Atmospheric Research, the National Science Foundation announced on Thursday.

item.title: Caryn Jarocki has more girls basketball wins than any coach in Colorado — and she’s not done yet
item.description: Thirty years ago, Highlands Ranch girls basketball put Colorado on notice about a dynasty in the making.

item.title: Federal judge orders Trump administration to keep paying Colorado public health grants
item.description: Colorado and three other states sued Wednesday to prevent the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services from halting $600 million in ongoing public health grants.

item.title: No victims found after shooter kills himself in Evergreen, Jeffco sheriff says
item.description: The Jefferson County Sheriff's Office reported the shooting in the 32000 block of Ellingwood Trail in Evergreen at 5:14 p.m. and said there were "no known victims" as of 5:25 p.m.

item.title: Renck: Brian Griese is bullish on Bo Nix — and using sports to help better the world
item.description: "Bo improved last season, and that isn't always the case when the league gets film on you. He will continue to get better, but they are going to need a few more offensive weapons."
